component.name: CouchPad
component.summary: Controller-triggered TV sessions for KDE Plasma

description.p: Prepare a gaming session on your TV and restore your desktop afterwards. Supports KDE Plasma on Wayland with KScreen, PulseAudio-compatible audio, and evdev controllers.

This desktop integration package launches its bundled application on the host through flatpak-spawn. It has unrestricted access as your user, uses the existing shiftpad-linux preferences, and requires host glibc 2.36 or newer. It does not isolate the desktop backend in the Flatpak sandbox.
